_comment: vugg-canary config. vuggPath is resolved relative to this repo root. Since 2026-10-28 (boss) it is the canary's own vugg checkout, a detached worktree of the vugg repo (README: The target). Before every full run `follow` moves it to the newest <remote>/<branch>; a run that sweeps then installs (npm ci, only when package-lock.json changed) and compiles dist/ from source. Before that, vuggPath was the vugg checkout people work in, which sat on a September branch while main moved on.
_seeds_comment: 30 since 2026-10-28 (boss), down from 200: a 200-seed sweep took 31 h at v285 (9.3 min per seed across 41 scenarios; supergene_oxidation, tn457_barite_pulses, reactive_wall and bisbee are 74% of it), so it could not finish in a night. 30 seeds is ~4.8 h. GO BACK UP once the wall-dissolution proxy fix (vugg PR #41, branch perf/surface-raw-reads) is in main: the canary follows main, so its first sweep with the fix times the faster engine, and `npm run status` then prints '⚑ seeds: ~N fit 04:00–09:00 ... go back up'. Take the most seeds that fit and move diffThreshold.absPts with them (3 standard errors: 300*sqrt(0.5/N), i.e. 15 at 200, 30 at 50, 34 at 40, 39 at 30). status.mjs flags an absPts that doesn't fit the seed count.
_autoPush_comment: After each sweep, commit logs/<date> (the spine only — .gitignore filters the heavy regenerable tiers) and push to origin (Syntaxswine) for the off-machine longitudinal record. Set false to keep the spine local-only. A push failure is non-fatal: the sweep always saves locally first.

diffThreshold._comment: Alarm if a species' spawn-% moves beyond absPts (boss decision 3), OR a rare-but-present species moves by relMult-fold (fresh-eyes addendum — catches relative swings the absolute gate misses on low-frequency phases). absPts 39 and the 3-seed rare-species floor are the boss's 2026-10-28 values for 30 seeds: 15 pts was exactly 3 standard errors at 200 seeds, and 39 is the same at 30. The floor (rel_move and appeared/disappeared) is max(minPctForRel, 100*minSeedsForRel/N) of the smaller sweep: 10% at 30 seeds, back to 2% at 200. On the 10-26 sweep's own seeds, disjoint 30-seed blocks of one engine raise 0.8 false alarms per pair at these values (mostly rel_move) vs 4.4 at 15 pts / 2%.
